checked_properties: Exact source/destination host+boot checked on each remote action; yellow4..7 and aqua8..11 only.
Source inventory admits only immutable worker/protocol and once-published attempt metadata, plus cells with final commit markers; metrics/status do not select transfers.
Destination inventory hashes existing row/NPZ bytes; exact marker/file matches skipped and conflicting bytes rejected.
Manifest binds source/destination/worker ranges/helper; source streaming and receiver independently verify exact SHA and size.
No-clobber hardlink publication retains attempt staging; row/NPZ precede marker and destination metadata/references are verified before marker.
Safe relative-path/regular-file checks, symlink and traversal rejection, ordered tar entries and extra-member refusal protect exact destination layout.
SSH source manifest is actually written/closed to source stdin; pipe links source output to receiver, with original exits and local evidence retained.
Cleanup targets only helper-owned local SSH children; no remote scientific owner signaling.
Concurrent same-source receiver uses separate flock; disjoint source workers may transfer concurrently.
limitations: Snapshot transport completion is not scientific owner closure or result admission.
Transfer layer handles opaque outputs; stricter fixed source/model/input association remains independently enforced by approved analyzer.
scope: Transfer source and synthetic behavior only; root owns real network execution and final receipts. No model, arrays or live process metadata inspected by reviewer.
